title: A Detention for the Locker
author: Casper Kavanagh
blurb: Mirabel Fairweather, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
